title: Floating Machi Koro-style central illustration spec
purpose: Central illustration for a green Machi Koro establishment card.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only a central content illustration to composite onto a blank card template.
integration_context.background_requirement: Native RGBA transparency is mandatory. Outside the requested miniature and its integral base every pixel must have alpha=0. Do not render a checkerboard, field, gradient, glow, halo, vignette, shadow, scenery, sky, card furniture, text, coin, icon, or frame.
integration_context.text_policy: No text or text-like content: no letters, numbers, words, prices, labels, signs, graffiti, license plates, or pseudo-glyphs. The requested wordless brand mark is the only exception.

style_goal.primary_rule: Match cute simplified original Machi Koro establishment art without copying a specific illustration.
style_goal.core_formula: Cute simplified board-game miniature plus a familiar utilitarian Russian supermarket.

content.subject: A small iconic Russian Дикси neighbourhood supermarket.
content.description: A low boxy neighbourhood shop with a saturated orange fascia, restrained contemporary purple accent strip, cool gray facade panels, broad blue-gray windows, centered automatic doors, a shallow canopy, bollards, and one small official-style orange circular Дикси emblem containing a white Cyrillic Д. The front faces slightly right, the building's left side is visible, and depth recedes toward image left.
content.desired_read: A recognisable modern Дикси grocery rendered as a compact floating Machi Koro-style miniature.
recognition_details: vivid orange fascia with a thin purple accent
one compact orange circular emblem with a white Cyrillic Д, and no other lettering
broad simple glazing, automatic doors, and a shallow canopy
content.miniature_base: A compact rounded patch of worn asphalt with a short concrete curb, fully isolated on transparency.
simplify: facade into chunky orange, purple, gray, and glass-blue masses
glazing and light wear into a few graphic shapes
omit: all words, letters, numbers, signage, posters, labels, pseudo-writing, people, cars, shopping carts, product packaging, and advertising except the one requested Д emblem
all surrounding scenery, realistic textures, dramatic lighting, and full-card composition
content.target_impression: The same whimsical illustrator who drew classic Machi Koro establishments has drawn a deadpan, recognisable Дикси grocery.

final_prompt_summary: Generate only the described compact floating miniature: a low orange-and-purple Дикси neighbourhood supermarket on a small asphalt-and-curb slab. Its front facade faces slightly right, its left side is visible, and depth recedes toward image left; do not show its right side or depth receding right. Use clean outlines, chunky simple shapes, sparse detail, and flat graphic shading in a cute Machi Koro board-game style; no photorealism. Native RGBA transparency is mandatory, with alpha=0 outside the miniature. Include exactly one small orange circular Дикси emblem with a white Cyrillic Д and no other brand text. Do not create a card, background, sky, cast shadow, scenery, people, vehicles, product packages, letters, numbers, words, signs, labels, graffiti, or pseudo-text.
